title: walk.rs parse_structure: usize::MAX sentinel is confusing
description: parse_structure() uses usize::MAX as a sentinel for 'list was not active at entry time' in text_length_at_entry and html_length_at_entry. Then compares: usize::MAX == text_now (where text_now = 0 when None) to detect no-change. The sentinel is non-obvious and requires reading two lines to understand. Suggested rewrite: use Option<usize> — None when the list is inactive, Some(len) when active.
